notes.body: Gmail shows Amy contacted the San Luis Valley Intertribal Pow Wow on Jan. 4, 2024 at Crowwolf69@gmail.com. Historical reporting describes a three-day intertribal gathering at the Ski Hi Complex with hundreds attending and strong cultural/religious significance around dance and drums.
